mission.title: A Little Research
mission.description: Track one of Desayd's clones and recover the data it gives away.

npc.say: You sure you know how to use that thing?

phase.briefing:
Well, if it isn't everyone's favorite operative. It seems my earlier guess was correct -- Desayd has found a way to copy himself. He is spreading these clones around the Matrix like a bad rash. And I think you have some experience with rashes, no?
Now you must go meet with Avarice. He has a broadcasting device that will allow us to learn more about Desayd's methods.

enter.say: Well, this is the spot. Avarice has the signal broadcaster for you.

talk.say: So there you are, {player}. I've got the tracker for you.

done.say: You sure you know how to use that thing?

phase.briefing:
We will use the object you picked up to track the signal emanating from one of Desayd's clones, with a little twist: the clone must be killed for the device to work.
We've tracked down one of his little duplicates. So what are you waiting for? Get going!

enter.say: First things first, you'll have to plant that device in a computer near the target. I'll let you know when you're getting warm.
Warmer... warmer... hot! Look for a computer in here, and plant the tracking device on it.

objective.text: Plant the tracking device on the computer

done.say: Now that the device is in place, continue into the next room. My scans show one of Desayd's copies in there.
All right, the clone has been eliminated, and from what I'm seeing it looks like the device is transmitting. You can get out of there now!

near.say: You! You eliminated the other me... but don't expect this individual to be so easy!

phase.briefing:
There is a listening station nearby. This is where the data from that device has been sent.
Go in, get the data from the computer, and upload it. You can handle that, can't you?

enter.say: This should be pretty straightforward. The team here will show you where to pick up the data.
That's funny, the team for this listening station should be here... But anyhow, the data's in that computer.

done.say: Crap! It's missing... you're going to have to secure this area and find that data!
Well there's our listening team. You'd better search them and see if you can find that data.

objective.text: Upload the Disk at a hardline

mission.finish:
What a nasty little surprise... put together by Desayd, no doubt. Too bad for him it did not succeed.
You've done rather well, considering your abilities. Contact me again once we've had a chance to take a look at this data.
